skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Honey Pilferer
skins.content: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Honey Pilferer. Beehunter's sleepwear. Fluffy, soft, comfortable, tight-fitting, and easy to wash, this outfit is suitable for both home use and as sleepwear. What nobody expected is that Beehunter would head straight to the food festival.
skins.quote: These fresh, luscious berries are already driving people crazy. What if you dipped them in a touch of thick honey... Wait, did you see that Ursus girl just now?
